---
title: Actions
---

# Actions

The Gitlab connector exposes the following clients:

| Client | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| [`Client`](#client) | Manage GitLab projects, groups, users, repositories, branches, commits, merge requests, issues, pipelines, jobs, packages, registries, runners and instance administration through the GitLab REST API v4. |

---

## Client

The `Client` connects to the GitLab REST API v4 (`https://gitlab.com/api/v4`, or the base URL of a self-managed instance). It exposes 1859 operations.

### Configuration

**ConnectionConfig**

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `auth` | <code>http:BearerTokenConfig&#124;OAuth2RefreshTokenGrantConfig&#124;ApiKeysConfig</code> | Required | Provides Auth configurations needed when communicating with a remote HTTP endpoint. |
| `httpVersion` | <code>http:HttpVersion</code> | <code>http:HTTP_2_0</code> | The HTTP version understood by the client |
| `http1Settings` | <code>http:ClientHttp1Settings</code> | <code>&#123;&#125;</code> | Configurations related to HTTP/1.x protocol |
| `http2Settings` | <code>http:ClientHttp2Settings</code> | <code>&#123;&#125;</code> | Configurations related to HTTP/2 protocol |
| `timeout` | <code>decimal</code> | <code>30</code> | The maximum time to wait (in seconds) for a response before closing the connection |
| `forwarded` | <code>string</code> | <code>"disable"</code> | The choice of setting `forwarded`/`x-forwarded` header |
| `followRedirects` | <code>http:FollowRedirects</code> | Optional | Configurations associated with Redirection |
| `poolConfig` | <code>http:PoolConfiguration</code> | Optional | Configurations associated with request pooling |
| `cache` | <code>http:CacheConfig</code> | <code>&#123;&#125;</code> | HTTP caching related configurations |
| `compression` | <code>http:Compression</code> | <code>http:COMPRESSION_AUTO</code> | Specifies the way of handling compression (`accept-encoding`) header |
| `circuitBreaker` | <code>http:CircuitBreakerConfig</code> | Optional | Configurations associated with the behaviour of the Circuit Breaker |
| `retryConfig` | <code>http:RetryConfig</code> | Optional | Configurations associated with retrying |
| `cookieConfig` | <code>http:CookieConfig</code> | Optional | Configurations associated with cookies |
| `responseLimits` | <code>http:ResponseLimitConfigs</code> | <code>&#123;&#125;</code> | Configurations associated with inbound response size limits |
| `secureSocket` | <code>http:ClientSecureSocket</code> | Optional | SSL/TLS-related options |
| `proxy` | <code>http:ProxyConfig</code> | Optional | Proxy server related options |
| `socketConfig` | <code>http:ClientSocketConfig</code> | <code>&#123;&#125;</code> | Provides settings related to client socket configuration |
| `validation` | <code>boolean</code> | <code>true</code> | Enables the inbound payload validation functionality which provided by the constraint package. Enabled by default |
| `laxDataBinding` | <code>boolean</code> | <code>true</code> | Enables relaxed data binding on the client side. When enabled, `nil` values are treated as optional, and absent fields are handled as `nilable` types. Enabled by default. |

### Initializing the client

```ballerina
import ballerinax/gitlab;

configurable string token = ?;
configurable string projectId = ?;

final gitlab:Client gitlabClient = check new ({
    auth: {
        privateToken: token
    }
});
```

### Operations

#### Namespaces

<details>
<summary>getNamespaceSubscription</summary>

Retrieve namespace subscription.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | <code>IdOrPath</code> | Yes | The ID or URL-encoded path of the namespace. |
| `headers` | <code>map&#60;string&#124;string[]&#62;</code> | No | Headers to be sent with the request. Defaults to `{}`. |

**Returns:** `GitlabSubscription|error`

**Sample code:**

```ballerina
gitlab:GitlabSubscription result = check gitlabClient->getNamespaceSubscription("3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6");
```

**Sample response:**

```json
{
  "usage": {
    "max_seats_used": 1,
    "seats_in_use": 1,
    "seats_owed": 1
  },
  "plan": {
    "exclude_guests": false,
    "code": "200",
    "auto_renew": false
  },
  "billing": {
    "subscription_end_date": "2026-01-15T00:00:00",
    "trial_ends_on": "string",
    "subscription_start_date": "2026-01-15T00:00:00"
  }
}
```

</details>

<details>
<summary>listNamespaces</summary>

List all namespaces.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `headers` | <code>map&#60;string&#124;string[]&#62;</code> | No | Headers to be sent with the request. Defaults to `{}`. |
| `fullPathSearch` | <code>boolean</code> | No | If `true`, the `search` parameter is matched against the full path of the namespaces. Defaults to `false`. |
| `perPage` | <code>int</code> | No | Number of items per page. Defaults to `20`. |
| `search` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns a list of namespaces the user is authorized to view based on the search criteria. |
| `ownedOnly` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | In GitLab 14.2 and later, returns a list of owned namespaces only. |
| `topLevelOnly` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Only include top level namespaces. Defaults to `false`. |
| `page` | <code>int</code> | No | Current page number. Defaults to `1`. |
| `requestedHostedPlan` | <code>string?</code> | No | Name of the hosted plan requested by the customer. |

**Returns:** `Namespace[]|error`

**Sample code:**

```ballerina
gitlab:Namespace[] result = check gitlabClient->listNamespaces();
```

**Sample response:**

The raw response content as `Namespace[]`.

</details>

<details>
<summary>verifyNamespaceAvailability</summary>

Verify namespace availability.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|

| `parentId` | <code>int?</code> | No | The ID of the parent namespace. If no ID is specified, only top-level namespaces are considered. |

**Returns:** `NamespaceExistence|error`


```json
  "suggests": [
    "string"
  ],
  "exists": false
}
```

<summary>searchProjectCode</summary>

| `startDate` | <code>string?</code> | No | Date range to start from. ISO 8601 Date format, for example `2021-03-01`. Default is 3 months ago. |
| `environmentTiers` | <code>("production"&#124;"staging"&#124;"testing"&#124;"development"&#124;"other")[]</code> | No | The tiers of the environments. Defaults to `["production"]`. |

**Returns:** `error?`

<details>
<summary>searchProject</summary>

Search a project.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | <code>IdOrPath</code> | Yes | The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. |
| `headers` | <code>map&#60;string&#124;string[]&#62;</code> | No | Headers to be sent with the request. Defaults to `{}`. |
| `perPage` | <code>int</code> | No | Number of items per page. Defaults to `20`. |
| `notTargetBranch` | <code>string?</code> | No | Exclude merge requests with this target branch. |
| `numContextLines` | <code>int?</code> | No | Number of context lines around each match. Available with advanced and exact code search. Introduced in GitLab 18.11. |
| `targetBranch` | <code>string?</code> | No | Filter merge requests by target branch. Available with advanced search and the merge_requests scope. |
| `'type` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Filter work items by type. Only applies to work_items scope. Available types: issue, task, epic, incident, test_case, requirement, objective, key_result, ticket. |
| `notSourceBranch` | <code>string?</code> | No | Exclude merge requests with this source branch. |
| `sourceBranch` | <code>string?</code> | No | Filter merge requests by source branch. Available with advanced search and the merge_requests scope. |
| `notAuthorUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Exclude results authored by this username. |
| `search` | <code>string?</code> | Yes | The expression it should be searched for. |
| `ref` | <code>string?</code> | No | The name of a repository branch or tag. If not given, the default branch is used. |
| `regex` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Performs a regex code search. Available with exact code search. Introduced in GitLab 18.9. |
| `not` | <code>record &#123;&#125;?</code> | No | Filter out results matching the parameters supplied. Supplying a filter together with its negation matches either condition, which widens the result set. |
| `scope` | <code>"issues"&#124;"work_items"&#124;"merge_requests"&#124;"milestones"&#124;"notes"&#124;"wiki_blobs"&#124;"commits"&#124;"blobs"&#124;"users"</code> | Yes | The scope of the search. |
| `state` | <code>"all"&#124;"opened"&#124;"closed"&#124;"merged"?</code> | No | Filter results by state. |
| `page` | <code>int</code> | No | Current page number. Defaults to `1`. |
| `fields` | <code>("title")[]?</code> | No | Array of fields you wish to search. Available with advanced search. |
| `authorUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Filter by author username. A username that matches no user is ignored. Available with advanced search and the issues, merge_requests and work_items scopes. |
| `labelName` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Filter by label name. A result must carry every name that resolves to an existing label; names that match no label are ignored. Maximum 30 names. Available with advanced search and the issues, merge_requests and work_items scopes. |
| `confidential` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Filter results by confidentiality. |

**Returns:** `error?`

**Sample code:**

```ballerina
check gitlabClient->searchProject("3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6", search = "string", scope = "issues");
```

</details>

<details>

<details>
<summary>listProjects</summary>

List all projects.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `headers` | <code>map&#60;string&#124;string[]&#62;</code> | No | Headers to be sent with the request. Defaults to `{}`. |
| `repositoryChecksumFailed` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Limit by projects where repository checksum is failed. Defaults to `false`. |
| `withMergeRequestsEnabled` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Limit by enabled merge requests feature. Defaults to `false`. |
| `repositoryStorage` | <code>string?</code> | No | Which storage shard the repository is on. Available only to admins. |
| `lastActivityBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Limit results to projects with last_activity before specified time. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. |
| `minAccessLevel` | <code>10&#124;15&#124;20&#124;25&#124;30&#124;40&#124;50?</code> | No | Limit by minimum access level of authenticated user. |
| `simple` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Return only the ID, URL, name, and path of each project. Defaults to `false`. |
| `membership` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Limit by projects that the current user is a member of. Defaults to `false`. |
| `markedForDeletionOn` | <code>string?</code> | No | Date when the project was marked for deletion. |
| `customAttributes` | <code>record &#123;&#125;?</code> | No | Filter with custom attributes. |
| `archived` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Limit by archived status. |
| `searchNamespaces` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Include ancestor namespaces when matching search criteria. |
| `search` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return list of projects matching the search criteria. |
| `idBefore` | <code>int?</code> | No | Limit results to projects with IDs less than the specified ID. |
| `lastActivityAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Limit results to projects with last_activity after specified time. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. |
| `starred` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Limit by starred status. Defaults to `false`. |
| `wikiChecksumFailed` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Limit by projects where wiki checksum is failed. Defaults to `false`. |
| `idAfter` | <code>int?</code> | No | Limit results to projects with IDs greater than the specified ID. |
| `includeHidden` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Include hidden projects. Can only be set by admins. Defaults to `false`. |
| `imported` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Limit by imported by authenticated user. Defaults to `false`. |
| `topicId` | <code>int?</code> | No | Limit results to projects with the assigned topic given by the topic ID. |
| `updatedBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return projects updated before the specified datetime. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. |
| `perPage` | <code>int</code> | No | Number of items per page. Defaults to `20`. |
| `visibility` | <code>"private"&#124;"internal"&#124;"public"?</code> | No | Limit by visibility. |
| `active` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Limit by projects that are not archived and not marked for deletion. |
| `sort` | <code>"asc"&#124;"desc"</code> | No | Return projects sorted in ascending and descending order. Defaults to `"desc"`. |
| `withCustomAttributes` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Include custom attributes in the response. Defaults to `false`. |
| `includePendingDelete` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Include projects in pending delete state. Can only be set by admins. |
| `withProgrammingLanguage` | <code>string?</code> | No | Limit to repositories which use the given programming language. |
| `owned` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Limit by owned by authenticated user. Defaults to `false`. |
| `updatedAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return projects updated after the specified datetime. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. |
| `withIssuesEnabled` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Limit by enabled issues feature. Defaults to `false`. |
| `orderBy` | <code>"id"&#124;"name"&#124;"path"&#124;"created_at"&#124;"updated_at"&#124;"last_activity_at"&#124;"similarity"&#124;"star_count"&#124;"storage_size"&#124;"repository_size"&#124;"wiki_size"&#124;"packages_size"</code> | No | Return projects ordered by field. storage_size, repository_size, wiki_size, packages_size are only available to admins. Similarity is available when searching and is limited to projects the user has access to. Defaults to `"created_at"`. |
| `topic` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Comma-separated list of topics. Limit results to projects having all topics. |
| `page` | <code>int</code> | No | Current page number. Defaults to `1`. |
| `statistics` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Include project statistics. Defaults to `false`. |

**Returns:** `BasicProjectDetails[]|error`

**Sample code:**

```ballerina
gitlab:BasicProjectDetails[] result = check gitlabClient->listProjects();
```

**Sample response:**

The raw response content as `BasicProjectDetails[]`.

| `updatedBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return projects updated before the specified datetime. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. |
| `perPage` | <code>int</code> | No | Number of items per page. Defaults to `20`. |
| `visibility` | <code>"private"&#124;"internal"&#124;"public"?</code> | No | Limit by visibility. |
| `active` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Limit by projects that are not archived and not marked for deletion. |
| `sort` | <code>"asc"&#124;"desc"</code> | No | Return projects sorted in ascending and descending order. Defaults to `"desc"`. |
| `withCustomAttributes` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Include custom attributes in the response. Defaults to `false`. |
| `includePendingDelete` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Include projects in pending delete state. Can only be set by admins. |
| `withProgrammingLanguage` | <code>string?</code> | No | Limit to repositories which use the given programming language. |
| `owned` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Limit by owned by authenticated user. Defaults to `false`. |
| `updatedAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return projects updated after the specified datetime. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. |
| `withIssuesEnabled` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Limit by enabled issues feature. Defaults to `false`. |
| `orderBy` | <code>"id"&#124;"name"&#124;"path"&#124;"created_at"&#124;"updated_at"&#124;"last_activity_at"&#124;"similarity"&#124;"star_count"&#124;"storage_size"&#124;"repository_size"&#124;"wiki_size"&#124;"packages_size"</code> | No | Return projects ordered by field. storage_size, repository_size, wiki_size, packages_size are only available to admins. Similarity is available when searching and is limited to projects the user has access to. Defaults to `"created_at"`. |
| `topic` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Comma-separated list of topics. Limit results to projects having all topics. |
| `page` | <code>int</code> | No | Current page number. Defaults to `1`. |

**Returns:** `Project[]|error`

**Sample code:**

```ballerina
gitlab:Project[] result = check gitlabClient->listForks("3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6");
```

**Sample response:**

The raw response content as `Project[]`.

<details>
<summary>listProjectMergeRequests</summary>

List all project merge requests.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | <code>IdOrPath</code> | Yes | The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. |
| `headers` | <code>map&#60;string&#124;string[]&#62;</code> | No | Headers to be sent with the request. Defaults to `{}`. |
| `notAssigneeId` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned merge requests. `Any` returns merge requests with an assignee. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_username]`. |
| `deployedAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests deployed after the given date/time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `createdAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests created on or after the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `mergeUserId` | <code>int?</code> | No | Returns merge requests which have been merged by the user with the given user `id`. Mutually exclusive with `merge_user_username`. |
| `myReactionEmoji` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests reacted by the authenticated user by the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues not given a reaction. `Any` returns issues given at least one reaction. |
| `mergedAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests merged on or after the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `view` | <code>"simple"?</code> | No | If simple, returns the `iid`, URL, title, description, and basic state of merge request. |
| `draft` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Filter merge requests against their `draft` status. `true` to return only draft merge requests, `false` to return non-draft merge requests. Mutually exclusive with `wip`. |
| `state` | <code>"opened"&#124;"closed"&#124;"locked"&#124;"merged"&#124;"all"</code> | No | Returns `all` merge requests or just those that are `opened`, `closed`, `locked`, or `merged`. Defaults to `"all"`. |
| `notReviewerId` | <code>int?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given user `id`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with `not[reviewer_username]`. |
| `iids` | <code>int[]?</code> | No | Returns the request having the given `iid`. |
| `approvedByUsernames` | <code>ListOrKeyword</code> | No | Return merge requests which have been approved by the specified users with the given usernames. Mutually exclusive with `approved_by_ids`. |
| `perPage` | <code>int</code> | No | Number of items per page. Defaults to `20`. |
| `deployedBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests deployed before the given date/time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `'in` | <code>string?</code> | No | Modify the scope of the search attribute. `title`, `description`, or a string joining them with comma. |
| `targetBranch` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests with the given target branch. |
| `sort` | <code>"asc"&#124;"desc"</code> | No | Returns merge requests sorted in `asc` or `desc` order. Defaults to `"desc"`. |
| `labels` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Returns merge requests matching a comma-separated list of labels. `None` lists all merge requests with no labels. `Any` lists all merge requests with at least one label. Predefined names are case-insensitive. |
| `notAuthorUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_id]`. |
| `notLabels` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests matching a comma-separated list of labels. `None` lists all merge requests with no labels. `Any` lists all merge requests with at least one label. Predefined names are case-insensitive. |
| `notMilestone` | <code>string?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests for a specific milestone. `None` returns merge requests with no milestone. `Any` returns merge requests that have an assigned milestone. |
| `createdBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests created on or before the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `notAuthorId` | <code>int?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests created by the given user `id`. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_username]`. |
| `approverIds` | <code>ListOrKeyword</code> | No | Return merge requests which have specified the users with the given IDs as an individual approver. |
| `page` | <code>int</code> | No | Current page number. Defaults to `1`. |
| `authorId` | <code>int?</code> | No | Returns merge requests created by the given user `id`. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`. Mutually exclusive with `author_username`. |
| `withMergeStatusRecheck` | <code>boolean</code> | No | If `true`, this projection requests (but does not guarantee) that the `merge_status` field be recalculated asynchronously. Introduced in GitLab 13.0. Defaults to `false`. |
| `approvedByIds` | <code>ListOrKeyword</code> | No | Return merge requests which have been approved by the specified users with the given IDs. Mutually exclusive with `approved_by_usernames`. |
| `sourceBranch` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests with the given source branch. |
| `mergedBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests merged on or before the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `search` | <code>string?</code> | No | Search merge requests against their `title` and `description`. |
| `not` | <code>record &#123;&#125;?</code> | No | Returns merge requests that do not match the parameters supplied. |
| `notAssigneeUsername` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_id]`. |
| `scope` | <code>"created-by-me"&#124;"assigned-to-me"&#124;"created_by_me"&#124;"assigned_to_me"&#124;"reviews_for_me"&#124;"all"?</code> | No | Returns merge requests for the given scope: `created_by_me`, `assigned_to_me`, `reviews_for_me` or `all`. |
| `assigneeId` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | Returns merge requests assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned merge requests. `Any` returns merge requests with an assignee. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_username`. |
| `reviewerUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given `username`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Introduced in GitLab 13.8. Mutually exclusive with `reviewer_id`. |
| `withLabelsDetails` | <code>boolean</code> | No | If `true`, response returns more details for each label in labels field: `:name`,`:color`, `:description`, `:description_html`, `:text_color`. Defaults to `false`. |
| `wip` | <code>"yes"&#124;"no"?</code> | No | Deprecated. Use `draft` instead. Filter merge requests against their `wip` status. `yes` to return only draft merge requests, `no` to return non-draft merge requests. Mutually exclusive with `draft`. |
| `updatedBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests updated on or before the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `sourceProjectId` | <code>int?</code> | No | Returns merge requests with the given source project id. |
| `notMyReactionEmoji` | <code>string?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests reacted by the authenticated user by the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues not given a reaction. `Any` returns issues given at least one reaction. |
| `environment` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests deployed to the given environment. |
| `milestone` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests for a specific milestone. `None` returns merge requests with no milestone. `Any` returns merge requests that have an assigned milestone. |
| `notReviewerUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given `username`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Introduced in GitLab 13.8. Mutually exclusive with `not[reviewer_id]`. |
| `reviewerId` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given user `id`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with `reviewer_username`. |
| `updatedAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests updated on or after the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `orderBy` | <code>"created_at"&#124;"label_priority"&#124;"milestone_due"&#124;"popularity"&#124;"priority"&#124;"title"&#124;"updated_at"&#124;"merged_at"</code> | No | Returns merge requests ordered by `created_at`, `label_priority`, `milestone_due`, `popularity`, `priority`, `title`, `updated_at` or `merged_at` fields. Introduced in GitLab 14.8. Defaults to `"created_at"`. |
| `mergeUserUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests which have been merged by the user with the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `merge_user_id`. |
| `authorUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`. |
| `assigneeUsername` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_id`. |

**Returns:** `MergeRequestBasic[]|error`

**Sample code:**

<details>
<summary>listProjectIssues</summary>

List all project issues.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | <code>IdOrPath</code> | Yes | The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. |
| `headers` | <code>map&#60;string&#124;string[]&#62;</code> | No | Headers to be sent with the request. Defaults to `{}`. |
| `notAssigneeId` | <code>int?</code> | No | Return issues which are not assigned to the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_username]`. |
| `cursor` | <code>string?</code> | No | Cursor for obtaining the next set of records. |
| `createdAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues created after the specified time. |
| `milestoneId` | <code>"Any"&#124;"None"&#124;"Upcoming"&#124;"Started"?</code> | No | Return issues assigned to milestones with the specified timebox value ("Any", "None", "Upcoming" or "Started"). Mutually exclusive with `milestone`. |
| `myReactionEmoji` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues reacted by the authenticated user by the given emoji. |
| `notMilestoneId` | <code>"Any"&#124;"None"&#124;"Upcoming"&#124;"Started"?</code> | No | Return issues assigned to milestones without the specified timebox value ("Any", "None", "Upcoming" or "Started"). Mutually exclusive with `not[milestone]`. |
| `notIterationTitle` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues which are not assigned to the iteration with the given title. Mutually exclusive with `not[iteration_id]`. |
| `search` | <code>string?</code> | No | Search issues for text present in the title, description, or any combination of these. |
| `not` | <code>record &#123;&#125;?</code> | No | Filters by the specified parameters. |
| `notAssigneeUsername` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Return issues which are not assigned to the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_id]`. |
| `scope` | <code>"created-by-me"&#124;"assigned-to-me"&#124;"created_by_me"&#124;"assigned_to_me"&#124;"all"?</code> | No | Return issues for the given scope: `created_by_me`, `assigned_to_me` or `all`. |
| `state` | <code>"opened"&#124;"closed"&#124;"all"</code> | No | Return opened, closed, or all issues. Defaults to `"all"`. |
| `healthStatus` | <code>"on_track"&#124;"needs_attention"&#124;"at_risk"&#124;"none"&#124;"any"?</code> | No | The health status of the issue. Must be one of: on_track, needs_attention, at_risk, none, any. |
| `iids` | <code>int[]?</code> | No | The IID array of issues. |
| `withLabelsDetails` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Return titles of labels and other details. Defaults to `false`. |
| `assigneeId` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | Return issues which are assigned to the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_username`. |
| `confidential` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Filter confidential or public issues. |
| `updatedBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues updated before the specified time. |
| `perPage` | <code>int</code> | No | Number of items per page. Defaults to `20`. |
| `'in` | <code>string?</code> | No | `title`, `description`, or a string joining them with comma. |
| `dueDate` | <code>"0"&#124;"any"&#124;"today"&#124;"tomorrow"&#124;"overdue"&#124;"week"&#124;"month"&#124;"next_month_and_previous_two_weeks"&#124;""?</code> | No | Return issues that have no due date (`0`), or whose due date is this week, this month, between two weeks ago and next month, or which are overdue. Accepts: `overdue`, `week`, `month`, `next_month_and_previous_two_weeks`, `0`. |
| `issueType` | <code>"issue"&#124;"incident"&#124;"test_case"&#124;"requirement"&#124;"task"&#124;"ticket"?</code> | No | The type of the issue. Accepts: issue, incident, test_case, requirement, task, ticket. |
| `weight` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | The weight of the issue. |
| `sort` | <code>"asc"&#124;"desc"</code> | No | Return issues sorted in `asc` or `desc` order. Defaults to `"desc"`. |
| `notIterationId` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | Return issues which are not assigned to the iteration with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[iteration_title]`. |
| `labels` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Comma-separated list of label names. |
| `notAuthorUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues which are not authored by the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_id]`. |
| `iterationId` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | Return issues which are assigned to the iteration with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `iteration_title`. |
| `closedById` | <code>int?</code> | No | Return issues which were closed by the user with the given ID. |
| `notLabels` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Comma-separated list of label names. |
| `notMilestone` | <code>string?</code> | No | Milestone title. Mutually exclusive with `not[milestone_id]`. |
| `milestone` | <code>string?</code> | No | Milestone title. Mutually exclusive with `milestone_id`. |
| `createdBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues created before the specified time. |
| `updatedAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues updated after the specified time. |
| `notIids` | <code>int[]?</code> | No | The IID array of issues. |
| `orderBy` | <code>"created_at"&#124;"due_date"&#124;"label_priority"&#124;"milestone_due"&#124;"popularity"&#124;"priority"&#124;"relative_position"&#124;"title"&#124;"updated_at"&#124;"weight"</code> | No | Return issues ordered by `created_at`, `due_date`, `label_priority`, `milestone_due`, `popularity`, `priority`, `relative_position`, `title`, or `updated_at` fields. Defaults to `"created_at"`. |
| `notAuthorId` | <code>int?</code> | No | Return issues which are not authored by the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_username]`. |
| `iterationTitle` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues which are assigned to the iteration with the given title. Mutually exclusive with `iteration_id`. |
| `page` | <code>int</code> | No | Current page number. Defaults to `1`. |
| `authorId` | <code>int?</code> | No | Return issues which are authored by the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `author_username`. |
| `notWeight` | <code>int?</code> | No | Return issues without the specified weight. |
| `authorUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues which are authored by the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`. |
| `assigneeUsername` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Return issues which are assigned to the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_id`. |
| `epicId` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | The ID of an epic associated with the issues. |

**Returns:** `Issue[]|error`

**Sample code:**


| `scope` | <code>"created-by-me"&#124;"assigned-to-me"&#124;"created_by_me"&#124;"assigned_to_me"&#124;"all"?</code> | No | Return issues for the given scope: `created_by_me`, `assigned_to_me` or `all`. |
| `healthStatus` | <code>"on_track"&#124;"needs_attention"&#124;"at_risk"&#124;"none"&#124;"any"?</code> | No | The health status of the issue. Must be one of: on_track, needs_attention, at_risk, none, any. |
| `iids` | <code>int[]?</code> | No | The IID array of issues. |
| `assigneeId` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | Return issues which are assigned to the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_username`. |
| `confidential` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Filter confidential or public issues. |
| `updatedBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues updated before the specified time. |
| `'in` | <code>string?</code> | No | `title`, `description`, or a string joining them with comma. |
| `weight` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | The weight of the issue. |
| `notIterationId` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | Return issues which are not assigned to the iteration with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[iteration_title]`. |
| `labels` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Comma-separated list of label names. |
| `notAuthorUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues which are not authored by the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_id]`. |
| `iterationId` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | Return issues which are assigned to the iteration with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `iteration_title`. |
| `notLabels` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Comma-separated list of label names. |
| `notMilestone` | <code>string?</code> | No | Milestone title. Mutually exclusive with `not[milestone_id]`. |
| `milestone` | <code>string?</code> | No | Milestone title. Mutually exclusive with `milestone_id`. |
| `createdBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues created before the specified time. |
| `updatedAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues updated after the specified time. |
| `notIids` | <code>int[]?</code> | No | The IID array of issues. |
| `notAuthorId` | <code>int?</code> | No | Return issues which are not authored by the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_username]`. |
| `iterationTitle` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues which are assigned to the iteration with the given title. Mutually exclusive with `iteration_id`. |
| `authorId` | <code>int?</code> | No | Return issues which are authored by the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `author_username`. |
| `notWeight` | <code>int?</code> | No | Return issues without the specified weight. |
| `authorUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues which are authored by the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`. |
| `assigneeUsername` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Return issues which are assigned to the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_id`. |
| `epicId` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | The ID of an epic associated with the issues. |

**Returns:** `error?`

**Sample code:**

```ballerina
check gitlabClient->getProjectIssuesStatistics("3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6");
```

| `createdAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests created on or after the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `mergeUserId` | <code>int?</code> | No | Returns merge requests which have been merged by the user with the given user `id`. Mutually exclusive with `merge_user_username`. |

| `myReactionEmoji` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests reacted by the authenticated user by the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues not given a reaction. `Any` returns issues given at least one reaction. |
| `mergedAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests merged on or after the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `sourceBranch` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests with the given source branch. |
| `mergedBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests merged on or before the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `view` | <code>"simple"?</code> | No | If simple, returns the `iid`, URL, title, description, and basic state of merge request. |
| `search` | <code>string?</code> | No | Search merge requests against their `title` and `description`. |
| `not` | <code>record &#123;&#125;?</code> | No | Returns merge requests that do not match the parameters supplied. |
| `notAssigneeUsername` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_id]`. |
| `scope` | <code>"created-by-me"&#124;"assigned-to-me"&#124;"created_by_me"&#124;"assigned_to_me"&#124;"reviews_for_me"&#124;"all"?</code> | No | Returns merge requests for the given scope: `created_by_me`, `assigned_to_me`, `reviews_for_me` or `all`. |
| `draft` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Filter merge requests against their `draft` status. `true` to return only draft merge requests, `false` to return non-draft merge requests. Mutually exclusive with `wip`. |
| `state` | <code>"opened"&#124;"closed"&#124;"locked"&#124;"merged"&#124;"all"</code> | No | Returns `all` merge requests or just those that are `opened`, `closed`, `locked`, or `merged`. Defaults to `"all"`. |
| `notReviewerId` | <code>int?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given user `id`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with `not[reviewer_username]`. |
| `assigneeId` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | Returns merge requests assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned merge requests. `Any` returns merge requests with an assignee. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_username`. |
| `reviewerUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given `username`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Introduced in GitLab 13.8. Mutually exclusive with `reviewer_id`. |
| `withLabelsDetails` | <code>boolean</code> | No | If `true`, response returns more details for each label in labels field: `:name`,`:color`, `:description`, `:description_html`, `:text_color`. Defaults to `false`. |
| `wip` | <code>"yes"&#124;"no"?</code> | No | Deprecated. Use `draft` instead. Filter merge requests against their `wip` status. `yes` to return only draft merge requests, `no` to return non-draft merge requests. Mutually exclusive with `draft`. |
| `updatedBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests updated on or before the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `perPage` | <code>int</code> | No | Number of items per page. Defaults to `20`. |
| `deployedBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests deployed before the given date/time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `'in` | <code>string?</code> | No | Modify the scope of the search attribute. `title`, `description`, or a string joining them with comma. |
| `targetBranch` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests with the given target branch. |
| `sort` | <code>"asc"&#124;"desc"</code> | No | Returns merge requests sorted in `asc` or `desc` order. Defaults to `"desc"`. |
| `sourceProjectId` | <code>int?</code> | No | Returns merge requests with the given source project id. |
| `labels` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Returns merge requests matching a comma-separated list of labels. `None` lists all merge requests with no labels. `Any` lists all merge requests with at least one label. Predefined names are case-insensitive. |
| `notAuthorUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_id]`. |
| `notMyReactionEmoji` | <code>string?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests reacted by the authenticated user by the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues not given a reaction. `Any` returns issues given at least one reaction. |
| `environment` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests deployed to the given environment. |
| `notLabels` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests matching a comma-separated list of labels. `None` lists all merge requests with no labels. `Any` lists all merge requests with at least one label. Predefined names are case-insensitive. |
| `notMilestone` | <code>string?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests for a specific milestone. `None` returns merge requests with no milestone. `Any` returns merge requests that have an assigned milestone. |
| `milestone` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests for a specific milestone. `None` returns merge requests with no milestone. `Any` returns merge requests that have an assigned milestone. |
| `createdBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests created on or before the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `notReviewerUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given `username`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Introduced in GitLab 13.8. Mutually exclusive with `not[reviewer_id]`. |
| `reviewerId` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given user `id`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with `reviewer_username`. |
| `updatedAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests updated on or after the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `orderBy` | <code>"created_at"&#124;"label_priority"&#124;"milestone_due"&#124;"popularity"&#124;"priority"&#124;"title"&#124;"updated_at"&#124;"merged_at"</code> | No | Returns merge requests ordered by `created_at`, `label_priority`, `milestone_due`, `popularity`, `priority`, `title`, `updated_at` or `merged_at` fields. Introduced in GitLab 14.8. Defaults to `"created_at"`. |
| `notAuthorId` | <code>int?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests created by the given user `id`. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_username]`. |
| `mergeUserUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests which have been merged by the user with the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `merge_user_id`. |

| `perPage` | <code>int</code> | No | Number of items per page. Defaults to `20`. |
| `ref` | <code>string?</code> | No | Name of the branch or tag. Default is the default branch. |
| `stage` | <code>string?</code> | No | Filter statuses by build stage. |
| `name` | <code>string?</code> | No | Filter statuses by job name. |
| `pipelineId` | <code>int?</code> | No | Filter statuses by pipeline ID. |
| `orderBy` | <code>"id"&#124;"pipeline_id"</code> | No | Values for sorting statuses. Valid values are `id` and `pipeline_id`. Default is `id`. Defaults to `"id"`. |
| `sort` | <code>"asc"&#124;"desc"?</code> | No | Sort statuses in ascending or descending order. Valid values are `asc` and `desc`. Default is `asc`. |
| `page` | <code>int</code> | No | Current page number. Defaults to `1`. |

**Returns:** `CommitStatus[]|error`

**Sample code:**

```ballerina

```

| `jobToken` | <code>string?</code> | No | To be used with triggers for multi-project pipelines, available only on Premium and Ultimate tiers. |

<details>
<summary>listGroupIterations</summary>

List all group iterations.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | <code>string</code> | Yes | The ID of a group. |
| `headers` | <code>map&#60;string&#124;string[]&#62;</code> | No | Headers to be sent with the request. Defaults to `{}`. |
| `includeDescendants` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Include iterations from parent and its descendants. Defaults to `false`. |
| `updatedBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return milestones updated before the specified datetime. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. |
| `perPage` | <code>int</code> | No | Number of items per page. Defaults to `20`. |
| `search` | <code>string?</code> | No | The search criteria for the title of the iteration. |
| `'in` | <code>("title"&#124;"cadence_title")[]</code> | No | Fields in which fuzzy search should be performed with the query given in the argument `search`. The available options are `title` and `cadence_title`. Defaults to `[title]`. Defaults to `["title"]`. |
| `updatedAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return milestones updated after the specified datetime. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. |
| `includeAncestors` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Include iterations from parent and its ancestors. Defaults to `true`. |
| `state` | <code>"opened"&#124;"upcoming"&#124;"started"&#124;"current"&#124;"closed"&#124;"all"</code> | No | Return "opened", "upcoming", "current (previously started)", "closed", or "all" iterations. Filtering by `started` state is deprecated starting with 14.1, please use `current` instead. Defaults to `"all"`. |
| `page` | <code>int</code> | No | Current page number. Defaults to `1`. |

**Returns:** `Iteration[]|error`

**Sample code:**

```ballerina
gitlab:Iteration[] result = check gitlabClient->listGroupIterations("3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6");
```

**Sample response:**

The raw response content as `Iteration[]`.

| `notAuthorUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return epics which are not authored by the given username. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_id]`. |

| `not` | <code>record &#123;&#125;?</code> | No | Object that contains filters. |

| `page` | <code>int</code> | No | Current page number. Defaults to `1`. |

| `authorUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return epics which are authored by the given username. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`. |

<summary>getGroupDoraMetrics</summary>

| `metric` | <code>"deployment_frequency"&#124;"lead_time_for_changes"&#124;"time_to_restore_service"&#124;"change_failure_rate"</code> | Yes | The DORA metric to fetch. |
| `interval` | <code>"all"&#124;"monthly"&#124;"daily"</code> | No | The bucketing interval. Defaults to `"daily"`. |
| `startDate` | <code>string?</code> | No | Date range to start from. ISO 8601 Date format, for example `2021-03-01`. Default is 3 months ago. |
| `environmentTiers` | <code>("production"&#124;"staging"&#124;"testing"&#124;"development"&#124;"other")[]</code> | No | The tiers of the environments. Defaults to `["production"]`. |

**Returns:** `error?`

**Sample code:**


| `iids` | <code>int[]?</code> | No | The IIDs of the milestones. |

<details>
<summary>searchGroup</summary>

Search on GitLab within a group.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | <code>IdOrPath</code> | Yes | The ID or URL-encoded path of the group. |
| `headers` | <code>map&#60;string&#124;string[]&#62;</code> | No | Headers to be sent with the request. Defaults to `{}`. |
| `perPage` | <code>int</code> | No | Number of items per page. Defaults to `20`. |
| `includeArchived` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Includes archived projects in the search. Introduced in GitLab 18.9. Defaults to `false`. |
| `notTargetBranch` | <code>string?</code> | No | Exclude merge requests with this target branch. |
| `numContextLines` | <code>int?</code> | No | Number of context lines around each match. Available with advanced and exact code search. Introduced in GitLab 18.11. |
| `targetBranch` | <code>string?</code> | No | Filter merge requests by target branch. Available with advanced search and the merge_requests scope. |
| `'type` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Filter work items by type. Only applies to work_items scope. Available types: issue, task, epic, incident, test_case, requirement, objective, key_result, ticket. |
| `notSourceBranch` | <code>string?</code> | No | Exclude merge requests with this source branch. |
| `excludeForks` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Excludes forked projects in the search. Available with exact code search. Introduced in GitLab 18.9. |
| `sourceBranch` | <code>string?</code> | No | Filter merge requests by source branch. Available with advanced search and the merge_requests scope. |
| `notAuthorUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Exclude results authored by this username. |
| `search` | <code>string?</code> | Yes | The expression it should be searched for. |
| `regex` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Performs a regex code search. Available with exact code search. Introduced in GitLab 18.9. |
| `not` | <code>record &#123;&#125;?</code> | No | Filter out results matching the parameters supplied. Supplying a filter together with its negation matches either condition, which widens the result set. |
| `scope` | <code>"wiki_blobs"&#124;"blobs"&#124;"commits"&#124;"notes"&#124;"projects"&#124;"groups"&#124;"issues"&#124;"work_items"&#124;"merge_requests"&#124;"milestones"&#124;"users"</code> | Yes | The scope of the search. |
| `state` | <code>"all"&#124;"opened"&#124;"closed"&#124;"merged"?</code> | No | Filter results by state. |
| `page` | <code>int</code> | No | Current page number. Defaults to `1`. |
| `fields` | <code>("title")[]?</code> | No | Array of fields you wish to search. Available with advanced search. |
| `authorUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Filter by author username. A username that matches no user is ignored. Available with advanced search and the issues, merge_requests and work_items scopes. |
| `labelName` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Filter by label name. A result must carry every name that resolves to an existing label; names that match no label are ignored. Maximum 30 names. Available with advanced search and the issues, merge_requests and work_items scopes. |
| `confidential` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Filter results by confidentiality. |

**Returns:** `error?`

**Sample code:**

```ballerina
check gitlabClient->searchGroup("3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6", search = "string", scope = "wiki_blobs");
```

</details>

<details>
<summary>listGroupMergeRequests</summary>

List all group merge requests.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | <code>string</code> | Yes | The ID or URL-encoded path of the group owned by the authenticated user. |
| `headers` | <code>map&#60;string&#124;string[]&#62;</code> | No | Headers to be sent with the request. Defaults to `{}`. |
| `notAssigneeId` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned merge requests. `Any` returns merge requests with an assignee. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_username]`. |
| `deployedAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests deployed after the given date/time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `createdAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests created on or after the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `mergeUserId` | <code>int?</code> | No | Returns merge requests which have been merged by the user with the given user `id`. Mutually exclusive with `merge_user_username`. |
| `myReactionEmoji` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests reacted by the authenticated user by the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues not given a reaction. `Any` returns issues given at least one reaction. |
| `mergedAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests merged on or after the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `view` | <code>"simple"?</code> | No | If simple, returns the `iid`, URL, title, description, and basic state of merge request. |
| `draft` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Filter merge requests against their `draft` status. `true` to return only draft merge requests, `false` to return non-draft merge requests. Mutually exclusive with `wip`. |
| `state` | <code>"opened"&#124;"closed"&#124;"locked"&#124;"merged"&#124;"all"</code> | No | Returns `all` merge requests or just those that are `opened`, `closed`, `locked`, or `merged`. Defaults to `"all"`. |
| `notReviewerId` | <code>int?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given user `id`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with `not[reviewer_username]`. |
| `approvedByUsernames` | <code>ListOrKeyword</code> | No | Return merge requests which have been approved by the specified users with the given usernames. Mutually exclusive with `approved_by_ids`. |
| `perPage` | <code>int</code> | No | Number of items per page. Defaults to `20`. |
| `deployedBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests deployed before the given date/time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `'in` | <code>string?</code> | No | Modify the scope of the search attribute. `title`, `description`, or a string joining them with comma. |
| `targetBranch` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests with the given target branch. |
| `sort` | <code>"asc"&#124;"desc"</code> | No | Returns merge requests sorted in `asc` or `desc` order. Defaults to `"desc"`. |
| `labels` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Returns merge requests matching a comma-separated list of labels. `None` lists all merge requests with no labels. `Any` lists all merge requests with at least one label. Predefined names are case-insensitive. |
| `notAuthorUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_id]`. |
| `nonArchived` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Returns merge requests from non archived projects only. Defaults to `true`. |
| `notLabels` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests matching a comma-separated list of labels. `None` lists all merge requests with no labels. `Any` lists all merge requests with at least one label. Predefined names are case-insensitive. |
| `notMilestone` | <code>string?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests for a specific milestone. `None` returns merge requests with no milestone. `Any` returns merge requests that have an assigned milestone. |
| `createdBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests created on or before the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `notAuthorId` | <code>int?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests created by the given user `id`. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_username]`. |
| `approverIds` | <code>ListOrKeyword</code> | No | Return merge requests which have specified the users with the given IDs as an individual approver. |
| `page` | <code>int</code> | No | Current page number. Defaults to `1`. |
| `authorId` | <code>int?</code> | No | Returns merge requests created by the given user `id`. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`. Mutually exclusive with `author_username`. |
| `withMergeStatusRecheck` | <code>boolean</code> | No | If `true`, this projection requests (but does not guarantee) that the `merge_status` field be recalculated asynchronously. Introduced in GitLab 13.0. Defaults to `false`. |
| `approvedByIds` | <code>ListOrKeyword</code> | No | Return merge requests which have been approved by the specified users with the given IDs. Mutually exclusive with `approved_by_usernames`. |
| `sourceBranch` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests with the given source branch. |
| `mergedBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests merged on or before the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `search` | <code>string?</code> | No | Search merge requests against their `title` and `description`. |
| `not` | <code>record &#123;&#125;?</code> | No | Returns merge requests that do not match the parameters supplied. |
| `notAssigneeUsername` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_id]`. |
| `scope` | <code>"created-by-me"&#124;"assigned-to-me"&#124;"created_by_me"&#124;"assigned_to_me"&#124;"reviews_for_me"&#124;"all"?</code> | No | Returns merge requests for the given scope: `created_by_me`, `assigned_to_me`, `reviews_for_me` or `all`. |
| `assigneeId` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | Returns merge requests assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned merge requests. `Any` returns merge requests with an assignee. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_username`. |
| `reviewerUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given `username`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Introduced in GitLab 13.8. Mutually exclusive with `reviewer_id`. |
| `withLabelsDetails` | <code>boolean</code> | No | If `true`, response returns more details for each label in labels field: `:name`,`:color`, `:description`, `:description_html`, `:text_color`. Defaults to `false`. |
| `wip` | <code>"yes"&#124;"no"?</code> | No | Deprecated. Use `draft` instead. Filter merge requests against their `wip` status. `yes` to return only draft merge requests, `no` to return non-draft merge requests. Mutually exclusive with `draft`. |
| `updatedBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests updated on or before the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `sourceProjectId` | <code>int?</code> | No | Returns merge requests with the given source project id. |
| `notMyReactionEmoji` | <code>string?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests reacted by the authenticated user by the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues not given a reaction. `Any` returns issues given at least one reaction. |
| `environment` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests deployed to the given environment. |
| `milestone` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests for a specific milestone. `None` returns merge requests with no milestone. `Any` returns merge requests that have an assigned milestone. |
| `notReviewerUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | `` Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given `username`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Introduced in GitLab 13.8. Mutually exclusive with `not[reviewer_id]`. |
| `reviewerId` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given user `id`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with `reviewer_username`. |
| `updatedAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests updated on or after the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format. |
| `orderBy` | <code>"created_at"&#124;"label_priority"&#124;"milestone_due"&#124;"popularity"&#124;"priority"&#124;"title"&#124;"updated_at"&#124;"merged_at"</code> | No | Returns merge requests ordered by `created_at`, `label_priority`, `milestone_due`, `popularity`, `priority`, `title`, `updated_at` or `merged_at` fields. Introduced in GitLab 14.8. Defaults to `"created_at"`. |
| `mergeUserUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests which have been merged by the user with the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `merge_user_id`. |
| `authorUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`. |
| `assigneeUsername` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_id`. |

**Returns:** `MergeRequestBasic[]|error`

**Sample code:**

```ballerina
gitlab:MergeRequestBasic[] result = check gitlabClient->listGroupMergeRequests("3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6");
```

**Sample response:**

<details>
<summary>listGroupIssues</summary>

List all issues for a group.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | <code>string</code> | Yes | The ID of a group. |
| `headers` | <code>map&#60;string&#124;string[]&#62;</code> | No | Headers to be sent with the request. Defaults to `{}`. |
| `notAssigneeId` | <code>int?</code> | No | Return issues which are not assigned to the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_username]`. |
| `createdAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues created after the specified time. |
| `milestoneId` | <code>"Any"&#124;"None"&#124;"Upcoming"&#124;"Started"?</code> | No | Return issues assigned to milestones with the specified timebox value ("Any", "None", "Upcoming" or "Started"). Mutually exclusive with `milestone`. |
| `myReactionEmoji` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues reacted by the authenticated user by the given emoji. |
| `notMilestoneId` | <code>"Any"&#124;"None"&#124;"Upcoming"&#124;"Started"?</code> | No | Return issues assigned to milestones without the specified timebox value ("Any", "None", "Upcoming" or "Started"). Mutually exclusive with `not[milestone]`. |
| `notIterationTitle` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues which are not assigned to the iteration with the given title. Mutually exclusive with `not[iteration_id]`. |
| `search` | <code>string?</code> | No | Search issues for text present in the title, description, or any combination of these. |
| `not` | <code>record &#123;&#125;?</code> | No | Filters by the specified parameters. |
| `notAssigneeUsername` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Return issues which are not assigned to the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_id]`. |
| `scope` | <code>"created-by-me"&#124;"assigned-to-me"&#124;"created_by_me"&#124;"assigned_to_me"&#124;"all"?</code> | No | Return issues for the given scope: `created_by_me`, `assigned_to_me` or `all`. |
| `state` | <code>"opened"&#124;"closed"&#124;"all"</code> | No | Return opened, closed, or all issues. Defaults to `"all"`. |
| `healthStatus` | <code>"on_track"&#124;"needs_attention"&#124;"at_risk"&#124;"none"&#124;"any"?</code> | No | The health status of the issue. Must be one of: on_track, needs_attention, at_risk, none, any. |
| `iids` | <code>int[]?</code> | No | The IID array of issues. |
| `withLabelsDetails` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Return titles of labels and other details. Defaults to `false`. |
| `assigneeId` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | Return issues which are assigned to the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_username`. |
| `confidential` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Filter confidential or public issues. |
| `updatedBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues updated before the specified time. |
| `perPage` | <code>int</code> | No | Number of items per page. Defaults to `20`. |
| `'in` | <code>string?</code> | No | `title`, `description`, or a string joining them with comma. |
| `dueDate` | <code>"0"&#124;"any"&#124;"today"&#124;"tomorrow"&#124;"overdue"&#124;"week"&#124;"month"&#124;"next_month_and_previous_two_weeks"&#124;""?</code> | No | Return issues that have no due date (`0`), or whose due date is this week, this month, between two weeks ago and next month, or which are overdue. Accepts: `overdue`, `week`, `month`, `next_month_and_previous_two_weeks`, `0`. |
| `issueType` | <code>"issue"&#124;"incident"&#124;"test_case"&#124;"requirement"&#124;"task"&#124;"ticket"?</code> | No | The type of the issue. Accepts: issue, incident, test_case, requirement, task, ticket. |
| `weight` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | The weight of the issue. |
| `sort` | <code>"asc"&#124;"desc"</code> | No | Return issues sorted in `asc` or `desc` order. Defaults to `"desc"`. |
| `notIterationId` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | Return issues which are not assigned to the iteration with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[iteration_title]`. |
| `labels` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Comma-separated list of label names. |
| `notAuthorUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues which are not authored by the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_id]`. |
| `iterationId` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | Return issues which are assigned to the iteration with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `iteration_title`. |
| `nonArchived` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Return issues from non archived projects. Defaults to `true`. |
| `closedById` | <code>int?</code> | No | Return issues which were closed by the user with the given ID. |
| `notLabels` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Comma-separated list of label names. |
| `notMilestone` | <code>string?</code> | No | Milestone title. Mutually exclusive with `not[milestone_id]`. |
| `milestone` | <code>string?</code> | No | Milestone title. Mutually exclusive with `milestone_id`. |
| `createdBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues created before the specified time. |
| `updatedAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues updated after the specified time. |
| `notIids` | <code>int[]?</code> | No | The IID array of issues. |
| `orderBy` | <code>"created_at"&#124;"due_date"&#124;"label_priority"&#124;"milestone_due"&#124;"popularity"&#124;"priority"&#124;"relative_position"&#124;"title"&#124;"updated_at"&#124;"weight"</code> | No | Return issues ordered by `created_at`, `due_date`, `label_priority`, `milestone_due`, `popularity`, `priority`, `relative_position`, `title`, or `updated_at` fields. Defaults to `"created_at"`. |
| `notAuthorId` | <code>int?</code> | No | Return issues which are not authored by the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_username]`. |
| `iterationTitle` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues which are assigned to the iteration with the given title. Mutually exclusive with `iteration_id`. |
| `page` | <code>int</code> | No | Current page number. Defaults to `1`. |
| `authorId` | <code>int?</code> | No | Return issues which are authored by the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `author_username`. |
| `notWeight` | <code>int?</code> | No | Return issues without the specified weight. |
| `authorUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return issues which are authored by the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`. |
| `assigneeUsername` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Return issues which are assigned to the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_id`. |
| `epicId` | <code>IdOrKeyword</code> | No | The ID of an epic associated with the issues. |

**Returns:** `Issue[]|error`

<details>
<summary>listUsers</summary>

List all users.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `headers` | <code>map&#60;string&#124;string[]&#62;</code> | No | Headers to be sent with the request. Defaults to `{}`. |
| `excludeExternal` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Filters only non external users. Defaults to `false`. |
| `createdAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return users created after the specified time. |
| `customAttributes` | <code>record &#123;&#125;?</code> | No | Filter with custom attributes. |
| `search` | <code>string?</code> | No | Search for a username. |
| `blocked` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Filters only blocked users. Defaults to `false`. |
| `provider` | <code>string?</code> | No | The external provider. |
| `excludeInternal` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Filters only non internal users. Defaults to `false`. |
| `excludeActive` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Filters only non active users. Defaults to `false`. |
| `auditors` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Filters only auditor users. Defaults to `false`. |
| `withoutProjectBots` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Filters users without project bots. Defaults to `false`. |
| `externUid` | <code>string?</code> | No | Get a single user with a specific external authentication provider UID. |
| `twoFactor` | <code>string?</code> | No | Filter users by Two-factor authentication. |
| `perPage` | <code>int</code> | No | Number of items per page. Defaults to `20`. |
| `excludeHumans` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Filters only non human users. Defaults to `false`. |
| `active` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Filters only active users. Defaults to `false`. |
| `withoutProjects` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Filters only users without projects. Defaults to `false`. |
| `sort` | <code>"asc"&#124;"desc"?</code> | No | Return users sorted in ascending and descending order. |
| `withCustomAttributes` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Include custom attributes in the response. Defaults to `false`. |
| `skipLdap` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Skip LDAP users. Defaults to `false`. |
| `'external` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Filters only external users. Defaults to `false`. |
| `createdBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return users created before the specified time. |
| `orderBy` | <code>"id"&#124;"name"&#124;"username"&#124;"created_at"&#124;"updated_at"?</code> | No | Return users ordered by a field. |
| `publicEmail` | <code>string?</code> | No | Get a single user with a specific public email. |
| `page` | <code>int</code> | No | Current page number. Defaults to `1`. |
| `humans` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Filters only human users. Defaults to `false`. |
| `admins` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Filters only admin users. Defaults to `false`. |
| `username` | <code>string?</code> | No | Get a single user with a specific username. |

**Returns:** `UserBasic[]|error`

**Sample code:**

```ballerina
gitlab:UserBasic[] result = check gitlabClient->listUsers();
```

**Sample response:**

The raw response content as `UserBasic[]`.

<details>
<summary>listUserProjects</summary>

List all personal projects for a user.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `userId` | <code>string</code> | Yes | The ID or username of the user. |
| `headers` | <code>map&#60;string&#124;string[]&#62;</code> | No | Headers to be sent with the request. Defaults to `{}`. |
| `repositoryChecksumFailed` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Limit by projects where repository checksum is failed. Defaults to `false`. |
| `withMergeRequestsEnabled` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Limit by enabled merge requests feature. Defaults to `false`. |
| `repositoryStorage` | <code>string?</code> | No | Which storage shard the repository is on. Available only to admins. |
| `lastActivityBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Limit results to projects with last_activity before specified time. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. |
| `minAccessLevel` | <code>10&#124;15&#124;20&#124;25&#124;30&#124;40&#124;50?</code> | No | Limit by minimum access level of authenticated user. |
| `simple` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Return only the ID, URL, name, and path of each project. Defaults to `false`. |
| `membership` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Limit by projects that the current user is a member of. Defaults to `false`. |
| `markedForDeletionOn` | <code>string?</code> | No | Date when the project was marked for deletion. |
| `customAttributes` | <code>record &#123;&#125;?</code> | No | Filter with custom attributes. |
| `archived` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Limit by archived status. |
| `searchNamespaces` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Include ancestor namespaces when matching search criteria. |
| `search` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return list of projects matching the search criteria. |
| `idBefore` | <code>int?</code> | No | Limit results to projects with IDs less than the specified ID. |
| `lastActivityAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Limit results to projects with last_activity after specified time. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. |
| `starred` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Limit by starred status. Defaults to `false`. |
| `wikiChecksumFailed` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Limit by projects where wiki checksum is failed. Defaults to `false`. |
| `idAfter` | <code>int?</code> | No | Limit results to projects with IDs greater than the specified ID. |
| `includeHidden` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Include hidden projects. Can only be set by admins. Defaults to `false`. |
| `imported` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Limit by imported by authenticated user. Defaults to `false`. |
| `topicId` | <code>int?</code> | No | Limit results to projects with the assigned topic given by the topic ID. |
| `updatedBefore` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return projects updated before the specified datetime. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. |
| `perPage` | <code>int</code> | No | Number of items per page. Defaults to `20`. |
| `visibility` | <code>"private"&#124;"internal"&#124;"public"?</code> | No | Limit by visibility. |
| `active` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Limit by projects that are not archived and not marked for deletion. |
| `sort` | <code>"asc"&#124;"desc"</code> | No | Return projects sorted in ascending and descending order. Defaults to `"desc"`. |
| `withCustomAttributes` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Include custom attributes in the response. Defaults to `false`. |
| `includePendingDelete` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Include projects in pending delete state. Can only be set by admins. |
| `withProgrammingLanguage` | <code>string?</code> | No | Limit to repositories which use the given programming language. |
| `owned` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Limit by owned by authenticated user. Defaults to `false`. |
| `updatedAfter` | <code>string?</code> | No | Return projects updated after the specified datetime. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. |
| `withIssuesEnabled` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Limit by enabled issues feature. Defaults to `false`. |
| `orderBy` | <code>"id"&#124;"name"&#124;"path"&#124;"created_at"&#124;"updated_at"&#124;"last_activity_at"&#124;"similarity"&#124;"star_count"&#124;"storage_size"&#124;"repository_size"&#124;"wiki_size"&#124;"packages_size"</code> | No | Return projects ordered by field. storage_size, repository_size, wiki_size, packages_size are only available to admins. Similarity is available when searching and is limited to projects the user has access to. Defaults to `"created_at"`. |
| `topic` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Comma-separated list of topics. Limit results to projects having all topics. |
| `page` | <code>int</code> | No | Current page number. Defaults to `1`. |
| `statistics` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Include project statistics. Defaults to `false`. |

**Returns:** `BasicProjectDetails[]|error`

**Sample code:**

```ballerina
gitlab:BasicProjectDetails[] result = check gitlabClient->listUserProjects("3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6");
```

#### Search

<details>
<summary>searchInstance</summary>

Search an instance.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `headers` | <code>map&#60;string&#124;string[]&#62;</code> | No | Headers to be sent with the request. Defaults to `{}`. |
| `perPage` | <code>int</code> | No | Number of items per page. Defaults to `20`. |
| `includeArchived` | <code>boolean</code> | No | Includes archived projects in the search. Introduced in GitLab 18.9. Defaults to `false`. |
| `notTargetBranch` | <code>string?</code> | No | Exclude merge requests with this target branch. |
| `numContextLines` | <code>int?</code> | No | Number of context lines around each match. Available with advanced and exact code search. Introduced in GitLab 18.11. |
| `targetBranch` | <code>string?</code> | No | Filter merge requests by target branch. Available with advanced search and the merge_requests scope. |
| `'type` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Filter work items by type. Only applies to work_items scope. Available types: issue, task, epic, incident, test_case, requirement, objective, key_result, ticket. |
| `notSourceBranch` | <code>string?</code> | No | Exclude merge requests with this source branch. |
| `excludeForks` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Excludes forked projects in the search. Available with exact code search. Introduced in GitLab 18.9. |
| `sourceBranch` | <code>string?</code> | No | Filter merge requests by source branch. Available with advanced search and the merge_requests scope. |
| `notAuthorUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Exclude results authored by this username. |
| `search` | <code>string?</code> | Yes | The expression it should be searched for. |
| `regex` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Performs a regex code search. Available with exact code search. Introduced in GitLab 18.9. |
| `not` | <code>record &#123;&#125;?</code> | No | Filter out results matching the parameters supplied. Supplying a filter together with its negation matches either condition, which widens the result set. |
| `scope` | <code>"wiki_blobs"&#124;"blobs"&#124;"commits"&#124;"notes"&#124;"projects"&#124;"groups"&#124;"issues"&#124;"work_items"&#124;"merge_requests"&#124;"milestones"&#124;"snippet_titles"&#124;"users"</code> | Yes | The scope of the search. |
| `state` | <code>"all"&#124;"opened"&#124;"closed"&#124;"merged"?</code> | No | Filter results by state. |
| `page` | <code>int</code> | No | Current page number. Defaults to `1`. |
| `fields` | <code>("title")[]?</code> | No | Array of fields you wish to search. Available with advanced search. |
| `authorUsername` | <code>string?</code> | No | Filter by author username. A username that matches no user is ignored. Available with advanced search and the issues, merge_requests and work_items scopes. |
| `labelName` | <code>string[]?</code> | No | Filter by label name. A result must carry every name that resolves to an existing label; names that match no label are ignored. Maximum 30 names. Available with advanced search and the issues, merge_requests and work_items scopes. |
| `confidential` | <code>boolean?</code> | No | Filter results by confidentiality. |

**Returns:** `error?`

**Sample code:**

```ballerina
check gitlabClient->searchInstance(search = "string", scope = "wiki_blobs");
```

</details>
